title: EFT (String) Tower Building
summary: We develop a bottom-up framework to reconstruct the asymptotic spectrum of light towers in four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=1$ effective field theories directly from their Kähler potential. Our construction uses the Integral Scaling Relation, which relates the mass scales of towers becoming light at infinite distance to the tensions of EFT strings, together with the Emergent String Conjecture applied recursively upon decompactification.
